question: Who among the following cricketers is the brand ambassador of a fantasy sports gaming platform, Paytm First Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__.

__
 
• **Paytm First Games, a subsidiary of the digital financial service platform Paytm, signed cricketing legend Sachin Tendulkar as the brand ambassador for the platform, ahead of the 2020 edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Paytm** was founded in August 2010 in Noida, Delhi NCR by its founder **Vijay Shekhar Sharma** with an initial investment of US$ 2 million.

 
 
• It started as a prepaid mobile and DTH recharge platform and later added data card, postpaid mobile, and landline bill payments in 2013.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar **received the Arjuna Award in 1994.

 
 
• India's highest sporting honor in 1997, and the Padma Shri and Padma Vibhushan awards, two of India's highest civilian awards, in 1999 and 2008 for his outstanding sporting achievements.
 
• In **November 2013**, the Prime Minister's Office announced the decision to confer on him the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• As of 2021, he is the **youngest ever recipient **and was the **first player** to receive the award.
 
• In 2012, Tendulkar was nominated to the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• **Playing It My Way** is an autobiography book by Sachin Tendulkar.
